text.p: These are the leading stories in the Namibian press on Monday.
Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- At least 60 people were killed in road accidents in Namibia during the festive season and a further 80 people died of unnatural causes since November 29.
- Dam levels in Namibia are still dropping despite some heavy rain last week.

- The leader of the opposition Democratic Coalition of Namibia (DCN), Moses Katjiuongua, has criticised the approach of the Namibian government towards the peace process in neighbouring Angola. Katjiuongua said in a statement he was disappointed that Namibia did not seem to play any visible and meaningful role in trying to solve the Angolan problem.
